Both lack confirmed opposing returns before 579; status marked uncertain. No isolated permanent steps confirmed.

U-component shows a sharp dip near index 520 (e.g., -2.10469 at 528) and another near 550 (e.g., -1.47716 at 549), but recovery is incomplete and overlapping with ongoing N/E transients; no confirmed return before end of allowed context (579).
